200.description: Loaded runtime status and prompt identity. Resume clients must reject missing or mismatched model/prompt versions. No secret values.

post.description: Returns a real-provider hint. No browser API key required. Profile enums are validated. Server deadline is 15 seconds and disconnects abort local upstream waiting; this does not guarantee cancellation of work already started at the provider.

thought.description: After trimming, must contain 1 to 2000 characters; rendered only as plain text

400.description: Invalid JSON, scene, profile or thought; JSON error string

413.description: Request body exceeds 100kb; JSON error string

502.description: Provider failure or empty reply; JSON error string, no fabricated tutorResponse

503.description: API client not configured; JSON error string

504.description: Server deadline reached; JSON error string
